exam.label: LEVEL {n} TEST
exam.reviewThese: Review these lessons and try again:
exam.outsRule: With 3 outs (3 misses) you go back to home plate and retake the test
exam.out1: Out 1! Focus, don't let it get to 3 outs.
exam.out2: Careful, that's 2 outs! One more out and you go back to home plate and retake the test.
exam.out3: Three outs! The test is over. Back to home plate: review and try again.
exam.stageText: You now know the field, the positions, how the game works and the count.
exam.stageNext: Keep going with the Prospect stage: when you finish it, Pelotín earns the Prospect uniform.
exam.stageTextProspect: Pelotín now has the Prospect uniform.
exam.stageNextProspect: Level 9 is unlocked and the Star stage begins.
exam.stageTextStar: You now know how to hit, run, play defense, pitch with care and think like an All Star.
exam.stageNextStar: Pelotín now has the All Star uniform.
exam.stageTextLegend: Pelotín now has the Legend uniform.
exam.stageNextLegend: Level 17 is unlocked and the Hall of Fame stage begins.
exam.stageTitleHall: You made the Hall of Fame!
exam.stageTextHall: Pelotín now has the Hall of Fame uniform. You finished all five stages, from Rookie to Hall of Fame.
exam.stageNextHall: Your real baseball is just beginning: on the field, with your coach. Play ball!

game.label: MINI-GAME
game.locked: Pass the Level {n} test to unlock it
game.unlocked: New mini-game unlocked: {name}! Find it on the path.
game.batIntro: Pelotín is up to bat. Tap SWING right when the ball gets to home plate. If the pitch is outside the strike zone, let it go by!
game.batRule: Strike out and the game is over. Every time you get a hit, the pitcher throws a little faster.
game.chased: That one was outside the zone. Let it go by!
game.looking: That one was in the zone. You have to swing!
game.capReached: You've won all of today's mini-game balls. Come back tomorrow for more!
game.pitchIntro: Now Pelotín is the pitcher. The yellow target moves on its own: tap PITCH when it's inside the strike zone. Down the middle, the batter can hit it; the edges are harder to hit, but don't miss the zone!
game.pitchRule: Get three outs to finish. Every strikeout makes the target move faster.
game.middle: Right down the middle: easy to hit.
game.edge: On the edge! Tough to hit.
game.umpIntro: Today you're the umpire. Watch where the ball crosses the plate and call STRIKE or BALL. If the ball touches the zone, even just grazing the line, it's a strike. If it doesn't even touch the line, it's a ball.
game.umpRule: Three wrong calls and the game is over. The pitches keep getting faster.
game.wasStrike: It was a strike: the ball touched the zone or its line.
game.wasBall: It was a ball: it didn't even touch the zone's line.
game.flyIntro: Pelotín is playing the outfield. When a fly ball goes up, watch its shadow on the grass: that's where it will land. Tap the field to send Pelotín running there before the ball comes down.
game.flyRule: Drop three and the game is over. Every catch sends the next one a little farther.
